post.title: How Pinterest makes money from your mood boards
post.ig:
Pinterest's US & Canada users are one in six of its users, but bring in three-quarters of its revenue.
Pinterest made $4.22B in 2025, almost all from ads.
In 2025, each US & Canada user brought in $30.84 vs 83 cents in its Rest of World region.
Pinterest says 96% of its top searches don't name a brand, so shopping ads can win the sale.
Users hit a record 661M in Q3 2026.
Sources: Pinterest FY2025 and Q3 2026 results.
